Email Subject: CRITICAL: 500 Internal Server Errors across all US-East API endpoints
Sender: alex.ops@enterpriseclient.com
Body: Our production checkout service is completely halted because calls to your API are returning 500 errors for the past 12 minutes. This is a severe outage affecting our paying customers. Need urgent escalation and status update immediately.

{"classification": "urgent", "confidence": 0.98, "reasoning": "Production checkout outage affecting customers with 500 errors across API endpoints.", "draft_reply": "Hi Alex,

Thank you for reaching out, and we sincerely apologize for the disruption. Our on-call engineering and incident response teams have been immediately notified of the 500 errors on US-East API endpoints and are actively investigating this as a Tier-1 critical incident.

We are tracking this under Incident Ticket #INC-URGENT. We will provide updates every 15 minutes or as soon as we have technical resolution details.

Best regards,
SaaS Support Incident Response Team"}

Email Subject: Switching from monthly to annual billing & updating VAT ID
Sender: billing@fintechstartup.co
Body: Hello, we are currently on the Team tier paying $79/month billed on the 18th. If we switch to annual billing today, how does the 20% annual discount apply to our remaining monthly days? Also, where in the dashboard can we input our European VAT number so our invoices don't get charged reverse VAT? Thanks!

{"classification": "needs_reply", "confidence": 0.95, "reasoning": "Standard customer billing inquiry regarding annual discount proration and VAT ID configuration.", "draft_reply": "Hi there,

Thanks for reaching out! Here are the details for your billing questions:

1. Switching to Annual Billing: When you switch to annual billing, any unused days in your current monthly billing cycle (from today until the 18th) are prorated as an account credit and applied immediately against the discounted annual total (which includes the 20% discount).

2. Adding your VAT ID: You can add or update your VAT ID by navigating to Settings > Billing > Tax Details in your dashboard. Once saved, reverse-charge VAT will automatically apply to all upcoming invoices.

Please let us know if you need any assistance making the switch!

Best regards,
Support Team"}

Email Subject: Bug: CSV export fails with HTTP 413 when exporting > 5,000 transactions
Sender: dev-lead@retailmetrics.io
Body: Hi Support, we encountered a bug in the Transactions view. When filtering for a date range with more than 5,000 rows and clicking 'Export as CSV', the web client displays an HTTP 413 Payload Too Large error modal. Steps: 1) Go to Analytics > Transactions, 2) Select Date Range: Last 90 days, 3) Click Export CSV. We reproduced this on Chrome 122 and Safari 17. Can you look into this?

{"classification": "needs_reply", "confidence": 0.96, "reasoning": "Clear bug report with reproduction steps and browser details regarding CSV export payload size.", "draft_reply": "Hi team,

Thank you for reporting this issue and providing detailed reproduction steps. We have reproduced the HTTP 413 Payload Too Large error when exporting datasets exceeding 5,000 transactions, and our engineering team is actively preparing a fix for the export worker service.

In the meantime, as a temporary workaround, exporting the dataset in 30-day increments will allow the exports to complete without hitting the payload ceiling.

We will update you as soon as the patch is deployed.

Best regards,
Support Engineering Team"}

Email Subject: Feature Request: Slack webhook integrations for critical event alerts
Sender: alex@growthops.com
Body: Hey support team! We love the webhook dispatch system, but our on-call engineers live in Slack. Is there native support for posting failed webhook notifications directly into a Slack incoming webhook channel, or is that on your Q3/Q4 roadmap?

{"classification": "needs_reply", "confidence": 0.94, "reasoning": "Constructive feature inquiry asking about native Slack webhook integrations and product roadmap.", "draft_reply": "Hi Alex,

Thank you for the kind words and the great suggestion!

While native Slack webhook dispatch is currently scheduled for our Q4 roadmap, you can achieve this today by pointing your webhook endpoint to a Zapier or Make.com webhook URL that forwards notifications to your Slack channel with standard payload formatting.

I have logged your request with our product team to help prioritize native Slack channel routing. Let us know if you need help formatting the event payload!

Best regards,
Product Support Team"}
